data.name: Bamaniya
data.gender_notes: Bamaniya is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Bama’, meaning ‘Lord of the Earth’. The suffix ‘niya’ denotes protection. Thus, Bamaniya means ‘Blessed with God’s protection’. This name is revered in Hindu mythology and holds significant spiritual importance. The name Bamaniya carries the meaning “Blessed with God's protection” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bamaniya usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed with god's protection and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bamaniya is a name with deep spiritual significance. It represents the divine feminine energy of knowledge and wisdom, and is believed to bring blessings of intelligence and learning to those who bear it. It is also a name that resonates with the goddess Saraswati, the Hindu deity of knowledge, music, and the arts.
data.etymology: Bamaniya belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blessed with God's protection.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bamaniya total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
